QUOTE: Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_C` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` but not the two macros. Then call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)` ... Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` in the user config.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. Its diagram and the "but not the two macros" condition show that the runtime route only exists when the macros are unset, so the two are mutually exclusive.
